title: Dispatch across three different shapes
statement: Define a Shape class with an Area method that returns 0.0. Define Square, Circle and IsoscelesTriangle, three classes that extend Shape and override Area: Square with side squared, Circle with radius squared times 3.14, and IsoscelesTriangle with base squared divided by 2. Read a kind (1 Square, 2 Circle, any other value IsoscelesTriangle) and a measure, create the matching shape and write its area.

assertions.requirement: The statement asks you to solve it with a class.
